title.narrative: Program Continuation - Elimination of Malaria in Southern Africa

description.narrative: Multicountry Southern Africa MOSASWA - Malaria - Lubombo Spatial Development Initiative 2 NPC - LSDI-2. This program has the following goals: To build solidarity and jointly work collaboratively as public and private sector to accelerate and intensify from control to pre-elimination in southern Mozambique and accelerate the transition from pre-elimination to elimination of malaria in Eswatini and South-Africa, and, so as to achieve zero local transmission in Eswatini, South Africa and Maputo province by 2020 and achieve pre-elimination (TPR <5%) status in southern Mozambique by 2025. The objectives of this program are: To establish and operationalise the MOSASWA Malaria Cross-border Initiative to coordinate, harmonise policies, strengthen sub-national capacity and share expertise and strategic information among the three countries to accelerate to the goal of malaria elimination. Expand and sustain access to malaria elimination interventions across the MOSASWA region with particular focus on mobile and migrant populations (MMP), malaria risk localities and residents to rapidly reduce and interrupt malaria transmission. To strengthen capacity in the three countries for malaria surveillance, operational research and monitoring and evaluation to support elimination efforts, respond to outbreaks and resurgence, and generate evidence for intervention response. To mobilise resources and advocate for increased and sustainable malaria financing to achieve and sustain malaria elimination
